ytongame_hostingmenu.notice.title: §l§eBBSMC Localization Pack Notice
ytongame_hostingmenu.notice.intro: §fThank you for choosing the BBSMC localization pack. Before you start playing, please read the following information.
ytongame_hostingmenu.notice.section1_lin: §fThe BBSMC localization pack is generated through AI translation + manual review. There may be minor issues. If you find any translation problems, please visit our website: §n§bhttps://bbsmc.net§r§f, join our QQ group to provide feedback. We will address your feedback promptly and republish the updated modpack.
§fIf the modpack you are playing already has a complete manual translation, we also welcome you to use the more accurate manual translation.
ytongame_hostingmenu.notice.section2_lin: §fThe BBSMC localization pack contains server ads that only appear on the multiplayer server list and create world navigation tab, which do not affect gameplay. We need some revenue to support the translation server. §c§lIf you feel the ads affect your experience, you can manually delete the YTGame-HostingMenu.jar mod file from the mods folder.
